_about: Shared fixture for the Python and TypeScript implementations of the deterministic parsing layer. Both tests/test_parity.py and web/tests/parity.test.ts read this file, so a change to one implementation that is not mirrored in the other fails a test instead of drifting silently. Add a case here first, then make both sides pass.
_canonicalize_unit: Cosmetic unit spellings that must fold to one form or the same analyte will not line up across labs. Micro has three: the micro sign, Greek mu, and the ASCII fallback (umol/l, ug/l) — the last is lowercase-only so U/l keeps its enzyme unit. The count units print a superscript (x 10⁹/l) that a PDF text layer flattens to digits, so 109/l, x 109/l and x109/ l are all 10^9/l; only the exponents labs use (3, 6, 9, 12) fold, so x1000/µl is left alone. Spacing around the solidus is cosmetic too.
_parse_range: A printed reference range, in every notation the Czech and Slovak sheets and handbooks use. The cell often carries the unit with it (7,8 - 12,8 fl; < 50 ng/ml), so a trailing cell of at most three words is read as the unit and dropped. Two closed vocabularies say the numbers in front are NOT an interval: age bands (0 - 15 let), where the numbers are ages, and printed criteria (<1,0 negatívne), where they define a category. Anything else after the numbers only names a population (muži, nekuřáci) and the interval still stands.
_material_prefix: The code a lab prints before the analyte name, or null. Underscore is generic (any 1-4 letters); slash and hyphen forms are allowlisted to known material codes because a generic rule would strip 'anti-' from anti-TPO. A spaced hyphen is the Czech abbreviation convention (ALP - alkalická fosfatasa), never a material. A digit after the separator (S-100 protein, 25-OH) is never a material either. 's,p' stays one code — the lab printed both — and is compatible with s and with p in mapping.
_abbreviation_key: A trailing bracketed abbreviation is the second key a printed name is looked up under, after its full key: B_Střed.obj.erytr. [MCV] is tried as 'stred obj erytr mcv' and then as 'mcv', so every LIS that prints the bracket meets the bare MCV synonym whatever Czech long form it chose. Only a trailing [ABC] of 2-6 letters and digits counts; a bracket mid-name (Anti-HSV 1+2 IgG (CLIA) uses parentheses, not brackets) and a name without one yield null. norm_key itself stays one-to-one.
